scope: Read-only independent source and mathematical review; no runtime mutation or GPU execution

exactComposition.preservedIdentity: Q'-Q=H(L)-L; every original fine interaction captured by the exact paired residual R remains unchanged
exactComposition.conservation: If sum_i a_i H(L)_i = sum_i a_i L_i, then sum_i a_i Q'_i = sum_i a_i Q_i in every RGB channel, regardless of whether R has zero mean

necessarySourceContract: Evaluate the complete identity and groundcover composition together, with the SAME substitutions in every upstream/downstream consumer. Do not separately smooth wI, wG or palette endpoints and assume the cross terms survive.
Declare each substituted leaf signal by its source name, expression and frequency. A named-signal split is valid as a definition, but is not a proven spectral low/high separation.

Potential explicit fine leaves include detailField, grain, triFine and triMicro. medium, mesoField, triCoarse, geometric slope, shading-normal effects and all photograph/texture inputs require an explicit keep/substitute classification; do not omit them silently.

f0=0.5 may be defined as a neutral reference, but cannot be called the measured spatial mean of a deterministic finite field. E[F(c,f)] is generally not F(c,E[f]) because smoothstep, clamp, absolute value and multiplicative weights are nonlinear.

Incoming P must be recomputed under the SAME leaf substitutions for L=D(c,f0). Simply preserving P's fine detail omits target and weight interactions. R must be the exact difference of complete source evaluations.

Near-material/distance modulation and shading-normal dependence can make L camera dependent. A world-space precomputed L needs an explicit view-independent source evaluation; preserve actual view-dependent differences in R and qualify that split.
The selected f0 changes the coarse field even though Q=L+R+P is an exact reconstruction. It therefore needs a declared source rationale and cannot be chosen by fitting screenshot improvement.
transportConditions: Use symmetric edge conductance s_ij=s_ji>=0 with positive world-area a_i and no-flux protected boundaries.
For an explicit step H(L)_i=L_i+tau/a_i*sum_j s_ij(L_j-L_i), tau<=min_i a_i/sum_j s_ij makes each H(L)_i a convex combination of coarse neighbor values.

Convexity of H(L) does NOT establish 0<=Q'<=1 after adding signed R and P. A separate output gamut check is required; clamping would break the conservation proof. Any bound-preserving flux limiter must be paired/conservative and qualified, not a posteriori clipping.

Global or component mean preservation is weaker than preserving each local accepted meadow/soil appearance. Healthy protected controls need exact no-change constraints; unprotected controls need measured bounded change.

Preserving R exactly is a construction identity, not independent evidence that visible soil detail is retained. R may contain broad components because fine amplitudes are modulated by coarse masks. Final band improvement and detail remain independent screening requirements.
Screen-visible pixels do not define complete terrain connectivity, protected components, or area quadrature; avoid screen-space diffusion masquerading as world-space transport.

rayRefinementScreen.meaning: Nominal pixel-ray plus encoded-coordinate boxes are contradictory at some frozen samples. The existing image bytes remain verified. The extra ideal ray law is not qualified to tighten coordinate or area intervals.
rayRefinementScreen.prohibitedRepair: Do not discard contradictory samples or tune an empirical pixel/meter tolerance until the test passes.
rayRefinementScreen.requiredResolution: Reconcile source-bound uploaded matrix, raster precision, interpolation, viewport and presentation semantics, or recover world-area/connectivity from the already existing immutable scene mesh. No new GPU run is justified solely by this failed ideal-ray inference.

nextEvidenceAction: Prefer immutable scene mesh/index/role/protection source to establish world-area neighborhoods offline. In parallel, implement the paired full-composition evaluator with an explicitly declared source-leaf/reference contract. Validate exact reconstruction and conservative transport/gamut separately before any actual candidate capture.

discoveredDefect.cause: Exactly zero channel flux incorrectly constrained the shared RGB edge alpha using orientation-dependent endpoint budgets.
discoveredDefect.repair: Set channel cap=1 when flux==0 before taking common RGB minimum.
discoveredDefect.verified: 250 boundary/protected/zero-conductance/duplicate-edge/self-edge cases now pass; maximum reversal/permutation error8.88e-16.

reasoning: Accepted edge flux is added/subtracted symmetrically in integrated RGB mass.
Every accepted channel flux respects aggregate precomputed positive/negative endpoint capacities. A common alpha preserves pairing and RGB direction.
Zero flux imposes no capacity demand and now imposes no cap.
Protected incident edges are disabled; R remains unchanged by definition.
preconditions: Finite positive areas; finite nonnegative conductance; valid edge indices/shapes; finite RGB arrays; original Q in[0,1].
Current specimen does not explicitly validate every precondition; production implementation would need those validations.
limits: Synthetic arithmetic only. Actual source-qualified P,L,R,mesh area,protection and adjacency remain unestablished.
Flux limiting can prevent sufficient boundary improvement; no visual or GPU readiness follows.
Residual identity is construction preservation, not independently measured perceptual detail.
